item: English voiceover / subtitle needed if the voiceover is not in English
Packaging and product name must be clearly visible
Need to include an attention-grabbing hook within the first 3 seconds with product clearly visible
Need to apply product directly to the face using the dropper
Need to show the texture of the product clearly (on the back of the hand or on the face)
Need to show product being used consistently as part of a daily routine (morning / afternoon / evening)
Need to include a clear Before & After comparison (same lighting if possible)
Need to highlight the hydrating and rich texture from the high concentration of PDRN (1%) using captions or on-screen text
Need to mention that EUNOA is a pharmacy-exclusive skincare product available only in Korea
Need to tag on TikTok: @eunoa_official and need to be active / clickable
